identity: A Jordanian primary social-studies / national-education question bank — 20 items one per layout line covering cotton products, the largest governorate by area, where Jordanians live, forms of tolerance, Nabulsi soap, Karak and Ajloun castles, park and classroom rules, traffic-light colours, volunteer work, the hero of the Arab-Israeli war, negative social customs, road markings and traffic devices, healthy habits, recycling, family breakdown, plant-based industries, and one closing true/false. Option counts vary genuinely: mostly four, three in items 1, 17 and 19, and two (صح/خطأ) in the last. Spelling is loose throughout ('الأجار' for الأشجار @92, 'ماسبق' run together, 'تلقى' for تلقي).
law: §S. 95 boundaries over 328 tokens = 3.45 tokens/segment. Stem runs to the last token all options share; options are one segment each however long, and the catch-all 'جميع ما سبق' / 'جميع ماسبق' is always ONE option (recovered entry 7 — it appears five times here, at @86, @105, @137, @180 and @28).
